messages:
Maya: quick sync — want to align on a launchable observability surface for Console GA. customers keep asking for dashboards + trace hooks + cost breakdown + error analytics. what’s realistically MVP?
Liam: I think we can deliver dashboards + basic cost breakdown in GA. trace hooks are bigger (sampling + trace storage) so maybe a limited set.
Sanjay: Agreed. tracing hooks: can we scope to instrumenting the hot paths (inference RPC, routing) and emit span IDs + error tags? that would unblock most debugging.
Olivia: For error analytics, customers care about grouped root causes and first-seen trends. We can ship aggregated error groups (no full traces) and add trace-linking post-GA.
Priya: +1. Enterprise customers also asked for per-route cost attribution. That’s more infra work (per-request token accounting). Maybe ship a per-model/per-route rollup only.
Maya: sounds like a reasonable cut. Proposal: GA = dashboard templates (latency, throughput, cost rollups), aggregated error groups with top-N insights, trace hooks for hot paths (span IDs + error tags), and a per-route cost rollup. Defer: full trace storage + sampling UI, per-token billing drilldown.
Liam: implementation notes: 
```
- Dashboards: 3 templates (service health, cost rollup, error trends)
- Trace hooks: instrumentation points x3 (inference, router, fallback)
- Error analytics: group by fingerprint, show trends + sample IDs
- Cost: daily rollups by model and route
```
Sanjay: timeline risk: trace hooks require an SDK change to emit error tags consistently. need 1 sprint for SDK + 1 sprint for backend. if we parallelize dashboards work we can hit GA in 3 sprints.
Olivia: storage/cost: aggregated error groups are cheap. trace link feature is expensive because it multiplies storage by traces per error. 👍 to deferring.
Priya: compliance ask: logs with PII redaction — do we need gating for GA? some customers flagged this.
Maya: add redaction checklist to launch criteria. acceptance criteria draft: 
```
1) Dashboards: 3 templates present and editable, data latency < 60s for metrics
2) Cost: daily per-route/model rollup + UI breakdown, sample CSV export
3) Error analytics: grouped errors with top-5 fingerprints, trend charts, link to sample IDs
4) Trace hooks: instrumentation for hot paths, trace IDs emitted in error objects
5) Security: PII redaction checklist completed for exported CSVs
```
Liam: ok. owners: Dashboards -> Olivia, Cost rollup -> Priya, Error analytics -> Sanjay, Trace hooks -> Liam (SDK + runtime).
Maya: timeline: target internal beta end of sprint 3, enterprise beta mid-sprint 5, GA end of sprint 6.
Sanjay: can we add a graceful degradation plan? if trace backend is overloaded, fall back to aggregated-only and surface a banner.
Liam: yes — add fallback policy to rollout plan.
Olivia: I'll add dashboard wireframes to the product board and link to this thread.
Priya: I'll scope the per-route billing work and flag infra blockers in the ticket.
Maya: great — action items recorded. FYI @console-bot will post the meeting invite for the scope handoff with owners. :+1:
console-bot: Meeting created: "Launchable Insights handoff" Thu 10:00am — invitees: Maya, Liam, Sanjay, Olivia, Priya
Maya: thanks — will follow up with beta customer list and the redaction checklist.
